source_name: MOEA GCIS — Company Registration Basic Data (OpenData API)
organization: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce — Government Commerce Industrial Services (GCIS / 商工登記公示資料)
rate_limits: unspecified; query by 統一編號 (Business_Accounting_NO) confirmed working
notes: Official open company-registration basic data for ALL Taiwanese companies, keyed on the 8-digit 統一編號 (Business_Accounting_NO / Unified Business Number). Fully open JSON REST API, no auth/payment. Verified live: TSMC (22099131) returns full record. OData-style $filter/$top/$skip; the eq filter by Business_Accounting_NO works reliably; the Company_Name `like` filter was finicky (empty body in tests). Dates are ROC/Minguo (YYYMMDD, year = AD-1911). Responsible_Name is a natural person (PDPA — redact).

source_name: Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) — Listed Company Basic Info OpenAPI
organization: Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE / 臺灣證券交易所)
notes: Official TWSE OpenAPI; listed-company basic info (t187ap03_L). Verified live: 1,089 listed companies, full JSON. Rich fields incl. company code (證券代號), unified business number (營利事業統一編號 — JOIN KEY to GCIS), chairman/GM/spokesperson (PDPA persons — redact), industry, address, setup/listing dates (Gregorian YYYYMMDD), paid-in capital, English name/address, website, email, auditor. Many more endpoints under openapi.twse.com.tw (financials, dividends, governance).

source_name: Taipei Exchange (TPEx) — OTC Listed Company Basic Info OpenAPI
organization: Taipei Exchange (TPEx / 證券櫃檯買賣中心)
notes: Official TPEx OpenAPI; OTC (櫃買) listed-company basic info. Verified live: 890 OTC companies, full JSON (English field names). Includes UnifiedBusinessNo. (JOIN KEY to GCIS) and Chairman/GeneralManager (PDPA persons — redact). Complements TWSE for the OTC market.

organization: National Development Council (國家發展委員會)
notes: National open-data catalog; reachable (HTTP 200). It indexes the GCIS and TWSE/TPEx company datasets above rather than hosting a separate register. Use it to discover additional GCIS datasets (directors/董監事, branches/分公司, business registration/商業登記 for sole proprietorships).
